description: The menu kit of docs/MENUS.md: the files project.add_menu_kit copies into a game. This folder is not a project template (factoria new does not list it): it has no factoria.json.

parts.name: core
parts.description: Shared by every menu: the player's settings saved in storage (scripts/settings.js), the stack of panels that open over each other (scripts/ui/menu_stack.js), read-aloud for focused widgets (scripts/ui/read_aloud.js) and the menu.* strings.

parts.name: options
parts.description: The options panel: video, a colour filter, audio per bus, controls (rebinding every action of the game) and language, saved between runs (prefabs/ui/options.prefab.json, scripts/ui/options.js).

parts.name: credits
parts.description: The credits panel that lists the software inside the runtime (scripts/ui/credits.js).

parts.name: shop
parts.description: The shop panel for in-app purchases (scripts/ui/shop.js) and the behaviour that pauses a level while the store's overlay is open (scripts/store_events.js). Needs the products in factoria.json "platform" (docs/PLATFORM.md).

parts.name: ageGate
parts.description: The age gate for a game whose ads reach children and adults (factoria.json platform.ads.audience "mixed"): a neutral birth-year screen (prefabs/ui/age_gate.prefab.json, scripts/ui/age_gate.js) that tells the ad network whether the player is under the age of consent with platform.ads.setUnderAge(). The main menu, when added too, opens it once, before any ad; its tests/age_gate.test.js checks it.

parts.name: analyticsConsent
parts.description: The analytics question for a game whose factoria.json has an "analytics" section (docs/ANALYTICS.md): a short screen (prefabs/ui/analytics_consent.prefab.json, scripts/ui/analytics_consent.js) that asks once whether the game may count anonymous usage, and gives the answer to analytics.setConsent(). Nothing is sent before it. The main menu, when added too, opens it on its first run; the Options switch (options part) changes the answer later. tests/analytics_consent.test.js checks it.

parts.name: main-menu
parts.description: The title screen: scenes/menu.scene.json (Play, Options, Credits, Quit, with the options and credits panels in it), scripts/main_menu.js, and tests/recipe.test.js, the kit's test, which drives the menu with a gamepad only. Needs core, options and credits. The Shop button and panel, the line that opens the age gate and the line that opens the analytics question are written only when the shop, ageGate and analyticsConsent parts are added too (all parts by default).

parts.name: pause
parts.description: The pause menu (prefabs/ui/pause.prefab.json, scripts/pause_menu.js): Resume, Options, Main menu. Put one entity with scripts/pause_menu.js in every level; adds the "pause" action to factoria.json when the game has none.

parts.name: loading
parts.description: The loading screen (scenes/loading.scene.json, scripts/loading.js): the main menu's Play button goes through it to the first level.

parts.name: keyboard
parts.description: The on-screen keyboard for a player without a physical one (prefabs/ui/keyboard.prefab.json, scripts/ui/keyboard.js): put one entity with the script in every scene that has a TextField.

parts.name: dialogue
parts.description: Subtitles for spoken lines and hints: say(key, {sound, speaker}) in scripts/dialogue.js, drawn by a Captions entity. Its strings are the example lines captions.* (replace them with the game's own).
